For infantry and artillery units: If this **weapons** unit goes down to 1 **model** it has **-1 to hit**
For vehicle units ignore this.

sharedRules.name: Fixed
sharedRules.description: Can only fire in the **Front Arc** of the model.

sharedRules.name: Fanatic
sharedRules.description: If there are atleast 2 **models** in a unit with this they ignore **pin modifiers**  when making **moral rolls** and this unit can not be **destroyed** due to having more **pin markers** then its **moral** if it has 2 models. In **close combat** if a unit with this and atleast 2 models **looses** it actually counts as a **draw** and another **close combat starts**.

sharedRules.name: Open Topped
sharedRules.description: Takes Pins from any hits. **Weapons** gain +1 to Pen and +1 on Damage Tables result against attacks targeting the **Top Armour** of this **Vehicle**

sharedRules.name: Front Arc
sharedRules.description: Can Fire **Front Arc**

sharedRules.name: HE(X")
sharedRules.description:
Use X” **template** to determine hits but you **roll 1 hit roll** for all units in the template. In addition the weapon gains +X Pen and deal additional pins based on X:
- 1: D2 pins or D3 if the **hit unit** is in a building
- 2: D2 pins or D6 if the **hit unit** is in a building
- 3: D3 pins or 2D6 if the **hit unit** is in a building
- 4: D3 pins or 3D6 if the **hit unit** is in a building

sharedRules.name: Indirect Fire
sharedRules.description: This unit hits on 6s for its first **Fire Order** then in its next **Fire Order** hits on 5,6 and so if it targets the same unit however as soon as this model gets any other **order** besides **Fire Order** or the **target unit** has moved more then **2"** and this **model** is not **hitting** on 2's  this resets.

sharedRules.name: Landing Craft
sharedRules.description: The standard rules for transports apply to landing craft, with the exception that units must begin the game on landing craft and cannot mount onto them unless the landing craft is partially on solid ground.
